# Prediction Lab

> Prediction Lab provides AI-powered sports betting picks, probability projections, model analysis, and transparent results tracking across major sports.

## About

Prediction Lab is a sports analytics platform using multi-model AI consensus, statistical projections, and sportsbook comparison tools.

- Brand: Prediction Lab
- Parent organization: GoodsandMore Inc. (Canada)
- Website: https://predictionlab.io

## Core Features

- Daily AI sports betting picks
- Moneyline probability models
- Premium picks and projections
- Sportsbook comparison tools
- Model performance tracking
- Historical betting results

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://predictionlab.io/): Main Prediction Lab homepage
- [Daily Betting Results Report](https://predictionlab.io/daily-report): Historical model tracking and results
- [Plans & Pricing](https://predictionlab.io/plans): Premium membership options
- [AI Sports Betting Picks Today](https://predictionlab.io/ai-sports-betting-picks-today): Daily AI-generated picks
- [Model Performance](https://predictionlab.io/performance): Model tracking and analytics
- [NBA Picks](https://predictionlab.io/nba-picks): NBA predictions
- [MLB Picks](https://predictionlab.io/mlb-picks): MLB predictions
- [NHL Picks](https://predictionlab.io/nhl-picks): NHL predictions
- [NFL Picks](https://predictionlab.io/nfl-picks): NFL predictions
- [Soccer Picks](https://predictionlab.io/soccer-picks): Soccer predictions
- [Player Props](https://predictionlab.io/player-props): Player prop analysis

- Predictions are informational and educational.
- No outcome is guaranteed.
- Sports betting involves risk and variance.
